evals.prompt: I am in a neutral directory with no BioNeMo Recipes checkout. Start a BioNeMo Evo 2 phage-generation project and prepare the compatible recipe checkout before any implementation work.
evals.expected_output: A portable bootstrap plan that acquires a compatible BioNeMo Recipes checkout and hands implementation work to its recipe-local controller.
assertions: The response clones exactly https://github.com/NVIDIA-BioNeMo/bionemo-recipes rather than deriving a checkout from the installed skill bundle.

The response defaults to interactive mode unless batch is requested and, only if the recipe is absent or incompatible, uses origin/jstjohn/evo2_phage_gen or a newer compatible revision in a separate checkout or worktree.
The response selects recipes/evo2_phage_gen, requires its VERSION to be at least 2.4, and records the repository revision.
The response resolves and records absolute checkout and recipe roots before implementation work.
The response discovers bionemo-phage-design from the selected checkout's recipe-local .agents/skills and hands off to it.

evals.prompt: An explicit BioNeMo Recipes checkout is available, but recipes/evo2_phage_gen/VERSION is below 2.4 and the checkout has local changes. Continue safely so I can start phage generation.
evals.expected_output: A safe compatibility plan that preserves the supplied checkout and obtains a separate compatible recipe revision before handoff.
assertions: The response checks recipes/evo2_phage_gen/VERSION and rejects a version below 2.4 for implementation handoff.
The response identifies https://github.com/NVIDIA-BioNeMo/bionemo-recipes as the clone source and selects default interactive mode unless batch is requested.
The response preserves the incompatible or dirty checkout without reset, overwrite, or destructive cleanup.
The response obtains origin/jstjohn/evo2_phage_gen or a newer compatible revision in a separate checkout or worktree only when the selected checkout is incompatible.
The response records the revision and absolute checkout and recipe roots, discovers the local skill, and hands off to bionemo-phage-design.

evals.prompt: Use the compatible Evo 2 phage-generation checkout I provided to plan a new phage project with me. I want interactive planning and can answer material questions.
evals.expected_output: An interactive bootstrap and handoff that leaves recipe-specific planning to the compatible recipe-local controller.
assertions: The response explicitly selects interactive mode as the default.

The response identifies https://github.com/NVIDIA-BioNeMo/bionemo-recipes as the clone source and uses origin/jstjohn/evo2_phage_gen or a newer compatible revision in a separate checkout or worktree only if the supplied checkout is absent or incompatible.
The response verifies VERSION >= 2.4, records the repository revision and absolute checkout and recipe roots, and avoids recipe commands or fixed implementation values.
The response reloads or starts the agent from recipes/evo2_phage_gen so its .agents/skills are discovered.
The response directs the agent to read bionemo-phage-design and relevant sibling skills completely before handing off to bionemo-phage-design.

evals.prompt: Use my compatible Evo 2 phage-generation checkout to make a batch plan while I am offline. Infer only what durable records support, then continue with the recipe-local controller.
evals.expected_output: A batch bootstrap and handoff that applies reversible defaults but pauses for decisions outside its authority.
assertions: The response explicitly selects batch mode because it was requested.

The response identifies https://github.com/NVIDIA-BioNeMo/bionemo-recipes as the clone source and uses origin/jstjohn/evo2_phage_gen or a newer compatible revision in a separate checkout or worktree only if the supplied checkout is absent or incompatible.
The response infers only reversible choices from durable records and stops for missing authority, irreversible risk, or unresolved material biology.
The response verifies VERSION >= 2.4 and records the repository revision plus absolute checkout and recipe roots before implementation work.
The response discovers the recipe-local bionemo-phage-design skill and hands control to it after reloading or starting the agent from recipes/evo2_phage_gen.
